summary.headline: Best UK opportunity today: MTD onboarding still leads, with late-payment automation the best cashflow-focused second bet.
summary.best_opportunity: Making Tax Digital onboarding, cleanup and quarterly-support automation for sole traders, landlords and small accountancy firms
summary.why_now: HMRC live guidance says MTD for Income Tax started from 6 April 2026 for qualifying income above £50,000, expands to £30,000 from 6 April 2027 and £20,000 from 6 April 2028. That creates immediate setup work now and recurring quarterly admin support after launch.

top_opportunities.name: Making Tax Digital onboarding and quarterly-support automation
top_opportunities.description: Sell a fixed-scope package that checks eligibility, cleans records, connects bookkeeping software, installs reminder workflows and supports quarterly updates for MTD for Income Tax.
top_opportunities.why_now: Evidence is strong. GOV.UK says qualifying income above £50,000 for the 2024 to 2025 tax year must use MTD from 6 April 2026, then £30,000 from 6 April 2027 and £20,000 from 6 April 2028. This is active compliance demand, not a speculative trend.
top_opportunities.buyer: Sole traders, landlords, independent bookkeepers and small accountancy practices
top_opportunities.recurring_revenue: High - setup fee plus monthly or quarterly support
top_opportunities.founder_fit: Excellent for a solo engineer because the first offer is migration, workflow setup and admin reduction, not building a full accounting product.
risks: Accounting software vendors already own the core ledger, so the wedge must be onboarding, cleanup and reporting admin
Avoid regulated tax advice and position the offer as implementation and workflow support
top_opportunities.verdict: Best overall because the trigger is real, current and service-first, with a clean path into recurring support.

top_opportunities.name: Invoice chasing and e-invoicing automation for UK SMEs
top_opportunities.description: Build a productized service or lightweight SaaS that issues cleaner invoices, automates reminders, tracks promises to pay and gives owners a simple overdue-cash dashboard.
top_opportunities.why_now: Evidence is strong. GOV.UK says the late-payment crackdown is aimed at unlocking growth for 5.5 million small firms, and the Small Business Commissioner says moving to e-invoicing reduces invoicing costs by 60-80 percent. The buyer pain is immediate cashflow, so the ROI story is easy to pitch.
top_opportunities.buyer: Micro businesses, agencies, consultancies, trades firms and other B2B service SMEs
top_opportunities.recurring_revenue: High - monthly subscription or managed receivables retainer
top_opportunities.founder_fit: Very strong for a solo engineer because this is mostly reminders, integrations, workflow logic and reporting.
risks: Some buyers will assume their accounting package already solves this unless you frame the pitch around debtor days and collected cash
Messy data across Xero, QuickBooks and spreadsheet-led workflows can slow onboarding
top_opportunities.verdict: One of the best fast-cash opportunities because owners feel the pain now and value can be proven in weeks.

top_opportunities.name: AI lead-response and admin automation for trades and local service firms
top_opportunities.description: Productize missed-call text-back, instant web-form replies, quote follow-up, booking handoff and a simple pipeline dashboard for firms that lose work through slow response times.
top_opportunities.why_now: Evidence is directionally strong but weaker than tax or payments. The UK AI Opportunities Action Plan says government is ramping up AI adoption across the UK to boost growth, and that supports practical workflow automation offers. The opportunity is strongest when sold as faster lead handling and fewer admin hours, not generic AI consulting.
top_opportunities.buyer: Plumbers, electricians, HVAC firms, clinics, salons, cleaning firms and other local service operators
top_opportunities.founder_fit: Strong for a solo engineer because the stack is mostly messaging, CRM glue, forms, scheduling and reporting.
risks: Competition is visible, so a narrow niche and hard ROI framing are essential
Evidence for urgency is less direct than compliance or payment pain, so the offer needs strong before-and-after metrics
top_opportunities.verdict: Strong if packaged around recovered revenue and saved admin time rather than broad AI transformation language.

top_opportunities.name: Tender monitoring and bid-drafting assistant for SME suppliers
top_opportunities.description: Create a focused service or tool that monitors relevant tenders, scores fit, drafts first-pass answers and stores reusable case-study and compliance evidence.
top_opportunities.why_now: Evidence is credible. GOV.UK says measures around the Procurement Act will speed up and simplify processes in a public sector market where £400 billion is spent each year on goods and services. That creates room for a narrow monitoring and drafting layer, though sales cycles are slower than tax or cashflow services.
top_opportunities.buyer: Small consultancies, digital agencies, specialist service firms and compliance-heavy B2B suppliers
top_opportunities.recurring_revenue: Medium to high - retainer, seat fee or managed bid support
top_opportunities.founder_fit: Good for an engineer who can combine tender search, document generation and workflow tooling into a narrow offer.
risks: Tendering is episodic, so revenue can be lumpier than in compliance services
Bid-writing agencies already exist, so you need automation leverage or a tight vertical niche
top_opportunities.verdict: Promising niche B2B play, best when aimed at one supplier category instead of the whole procurement market.

top_opportunities.name: Cyber Essentials readiness and small-business security workflow automation
top_opportunities.description: Offer a fixed-scope package covering MFA, backups, account hygiene, device checks, phishing guidance and evidence collection for small organisations that need a better baseline.
top_opportunities.why_now: Evidence is real but the buying trigger is softer than tax or cashflow. The NCSC actively maintains a small and medium-sized organisations guidance hub, and its Cyber Essentials overview says the scheme is aligned to five technical controls designed to prevent the most common internet-based threats. That supports a checklist-driven, productized offer rather than bespoke security consulting.
top_opportunities.buyer: Small professional firms, charities, clinics, agencies and B2B service SMEs
top_opportunities.recurring_revenue: Medium to high - monitoring, policy reviews and periodic checks
top_opportunities.founder_fit: Good if you prefer structured technical delivery and keep the service standardized.
risks: Trust matters in security work, so some buyers will prefer established specialists
If the offer becomes too bespoke, part-time solo delivery gets much harder
top_opportunities.verdict: Viable as a productized operations package, but less immediate than the top two opportunities.

best_pick.name: Making Tax Digital onboarding and quarterly-support automation
best_pick.why_it_wins: It has the clearest live trigger, fits a solo engineer on a low budget, can be sold as a service before any software build-out, and naturally converts into recurring quarterly support or bookkeeping-adjacent admin retainers.
validation_plan: Pick one wedge first: landlords with simple property records or small accountancy firms that need extra MTD onboarding capacity.
Build a tiny demo showing record capture, reminder workflows and a client-status dashboard on top of off-the-shelf bookkeeping software.
Publish a fixed-price MTD readiness package with clear scope, turnaround time and a monthly or quarterly support option.
Contact 30 to 50 local accountants, bookkeepers and landlord-focused businesses before writing custom software beyond dashboards and automation.
best_pick.first_offer: MTD readiness setup for sole traders and landlords: records cleanup, software connection, reminder workflows and first-quarter support. Charge roughly £299 to £799 setup plus £39 to £149 per month depending on complexity.
best_pick.mvp: A thin internal tool plus off-the-shelf bookkeeping software, document capture, reminder automation and a simple dashboard for onboarding status and quarterly check-ins.
customer_types: Sole traders above the current MTD threshold
best_pick.do_today: Create a one-page MTD readiness offer, build a dashboard mock-up and start direct outreach to local accountants and landlord-facing businesses today.
